mentions.name: RunCoach
mentions.description: Running coaching app that generates adaptive training plans and structured workouts (splits, pace targets, reps) and sends them to a Garmin watch, using an intervals.icu account. A generated plan was validated by completing a first 22 km trail race with over 1100 m of elevation; the app is intended to replace a paid running app subscription.
mentions.problem: Replaces a paid running coaching app by generating training plans and structured workouts and delivering them to a Garmin watch for essentially the same benefits.
mentions.audience: Runners who want structured, adaptive training plans and workouts delivered to a Garmin watch, replacing a paid app (currently the author's own training use).
mentions.source_excerpt:
I keep chipping away at my running app, RunCoach!

I've recently managed to bridge the biggest gap I've had and, while it seems to be something that is NOT yet great from a UI/UX perspective (you need an account with intervals.icu to use it), I can now send workouts with structured splits, pace targets and reps to my Garmin watch, which effectively means I can replace using a paid app with my own to get, essentially, the same benefits.
mentions.author: brunooliv
